{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Filter for LOYAL and completed orders
df_loyal_completed = df[(df['customer_segment'] == 'loyal') & (df['status'] == 'completed')]

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'] = df_loyal_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Check for any non-numeric values after cleaning
non_numeric = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].isna().sum()

# Compute mean revenue
mean_revenue = df_loyal_completed['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print results
print(f"Number of LOYAL, completed orders: {len(df_loyal_completed)}")
print(f"Non-numeric revenue after cleaning: {non_numeric}")
print(f"Mean revenue (USD): {mean_revenue:.2f}")"}
